body:
This report is a compilation of two trips I partook on EPT, about a year ago. I'll try to keep them as close to original as possible.
***
Original title: EPT - warm and gentle, wild colours.
So I vaped 70mg EPT freebased yesterday, through a dab rig. Worked flawlessly, and the smoke was pretty smooth (still harsh tho, like DMT). I then spent the majority of the trip listening to some jazz with my eyes closed.
This resulted in the loveliest trip ever! The music was heavenly, the visuals were ethereal, flowing and fractal, not many defined shapes, just suggestions of shapes.  But the outstanding thing for me was the colours! I saw basically all the colours. And they were in the softest hues, and in the most unique combinations. I'd have my eyes closed seeing velvetty red, then, a burst of the most peculiar shade green, then a burst soft orange, then a burst of warm violet. Amazing colours!
Another notable thing was how amazing my body felt. I felt this overwhelming warmth all over. I was the most comfortable and relaxed I've been in a long time. Tryptamines for me make textures feel very soft in general, but EPT is the softest for sure. Felt like I was on a bed made of cloud and objects had the texture of a teddy bear.
I also felt very clear headed. At no point did I feel like I was tripping per se mentally.
Overall, 10/10 beginner tryptamine, will smoke 100mg next time.
***
So, since my last trip at 70mg, which was visually kinda disappointing but had amazing body high, clear head and wonderful colours, I concluded that upping the dose might bring out those intense sci-fi visuals I read about.
I had some 110mg left of my EPT, so I freebased and vaped it. What followed was intense confusion and quite a weird body load. 70mg felt like warm blanket, but this dose felt way too warm and uncomfortably prickly. Reminded me of the DiPT body high. Visuals were quite disappointing still, ethereal and vague. Seems like EPT is not a very visual substance, and more of a body high sensation. Music was okay but for the next 2,5 hours I was restless and couldn't find a comfortable spot.
Combining with nitrous did not increase the visual aspect either.
I then decided that I don't wanna listen to music and spent most of the trip in silence in deep introspection, which proved quite fruitful. This chemical definitely has the introspective push, but there's better substances for that imo.
Overall the trip lasted 2.5ish hours. High dose EPT is mostly lacking, there's better tryptamines out there.
***
EPT has a charm, it's very nice and comfy at the appropriate dose, and mentally the clearest psychedelic I've taken. The visuals are reminiscent of coming down from DPT, but very mild and vague at both doses I tried. It's wonderful at 70mg and would be amazing for cuddling, but is lacking depth or intricateness in my experience.
